description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio WriteBuffer task, testing buffer writing behavior with mock GstWrapper, including handling of partial buffers, failure cases, and alignment with bytes per sample.

classes.name: WebAudioWriteBufferTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudio WriteBuffer unit tests, setting up mock context and GstWrapper.

methods.name: WebAudioWriteBufferTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test fixture with default context and mock objects.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferForAllData
methods.description: Test that verifies writing the entire buffer when sufficient space is available.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferForAllMainDataAndPartialWrapData
methods.description: Test that verifies partial wrap data writing when space is limited.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferForPartialMainDataAndNoWrapData
methods.description: Test that verifies writing only the main data when wrap data is unavailable.

methods.name: shouldNotWriteBufferIfNewAllocateFails
methods.description: Test that ensures no write occurs if buffer allocation fails.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferIfBytesWrittenLessThanExpected
methods.description: Test that verifies partial buffer write when less data is written than expected.

methods.name: shouldNotWriteBufferIfPushBufferFails
methods.description: Test that verifies no bytes are counted if pushing buffer fails.

methods.name: shouldNotWriteBufferIfBytesToWriteLessThanBytesPerSample
methods.description: Test that ensures no write occurs if remaining bytes are less than bytes per sample.

methods.name: shouldWriteBufferThatNotAlignedWithBytesPerSample
methods.description: Test that verifies correct buffer size and bytes written when data size is not aligned with bytes per sample.
